title: The ssh daemon is stopped
fault: The injection stops the practice sshd.
prompts: What does the client message name as the failure?
Is the server machine reachable at all?
hints: Examine the port number in your command.
The port forwards into the container. Ask what listens there.
A published port answers with a reset when the daemon behind it dies; an unpublished port refuses outright.

reveal.wrong: The injection stopped the practice sshd, so the published port answers with a reset instead of a session.
reveal.fix: Start the ssh service again, and connect to the port that sshd really uses.
